exceptions.rationale: packaging 26.3 is a PyInstaller build-only dependency absent from the artifact; both declared alternatives are individually allowed, and this exact temporary exception addresses fail-closed SPDX disjunction handling only.

Unmodified PyInstaller 6.21.0 is build-only; upstream GPL-2.0-or-later terms include the bootloader distribution exception and Apache-2.0 runtime hooks, while the builder package is absent from the artifact.
PyInstaller hooks contrib 2026.6 standard hooks execute only during the approved build; runtime hooks are Apache-2.0 and the package itself is absent from the generated artifact.
autocommand 2.2.2 is vendored within build-only setuptools, which is explicitly excluded from the frozen runtime; this exception does not authorize redistribution.

@tauri-apps/api 2.11.1 is the direct runtime dependency and its code may enter the frontend, but both exact SPDX alternatives are individually policy-allowed permissive licenses; this exception covers only intentionally fail-closed OR-expression parsing and authorizes no unlisted license or package.

@tauri-apps/cli 2.11.4 is a direct development dependency used for Tauri build and development and is absent from the shipped frontend and frozen Core sidecar; both alternatives are allowed, so this exception is limited to OR-expression parsing.

The exact 2.11.4 Windows native package is an optional child of the build and development CLI and is absent from the shipped frontend and sidecar; both license alternatives are allowed and this exception covers only OR-expression parsing.

The native TypeScript compiler is selected only by pinned development dependency TypeScript 7.0.2, runs on governed repository source rather than researcher or imported content, and is absent from the shipped app and sidecar. Version 7.0.2 remains latest stable while 7.1 is development-only; replace at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.

The native TypeScript compiler is a pinned development-only tool that processes governed repository source and is absent from the shipped app and sidecar; the invalid-UTF-8 denial-of-service boundary does not enter production runtime. No patched stable TypeScript package exists, so replace it at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.

Go 1.26.4 embedded in the pinned development-only TypeScript 7.0.2 native compiler is affected by encoding/asn1 excessive-recursion denial of service. The compiler processes only governed repository source, receives no ASN.1 input, and is absent from the shipped desktop app and Core sidecar. Go 1.26.6 is fixed, but no patched stable TypeScript package exists; replace at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.

Go 1.26.4 embedded in the pinned development-only TypeScript 7.0.2 native compiler contains the x/net/idna Punycode-equivalence flaw. This compile-only tool performs no product authorization or attacker-controlled hostname normalization, processes only governed repository source, and is absent from the shipped desktop app and Core sidecar. Go 1.26.6 is fixed, but no patched stable TypeScript package exists; replace at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.

Go 1.26.4 embedded in the pinned development-only TypeScript 7.0.2 native compiler is affected by invalid DNS-record parsing denial of service. The compiler exposes no DNS client/server or untrusted DNS-packet boundary, processes only governed repository source, and is absent from the shipped desktop app and Core sidecar. Go 1.26.6 is fixed, but no patched stable TypeScript package exists; replace at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.

Go 1.26.4 embedded in the pinned development-only TypeScript 7.0.2 native compiler is affected by the unencrypted HTTP/2 denial-of-service flaw. Go 1.26.6 is fixed, but no patched stable TypeScript package exists; replace at the first patched stable release and remove this exception.
